svg.title: Space observatory architecture
svg.desc: A simplified fictional space observatory, informed by NASA and STScI documentation. Ground operations exchange commands and telemetry with a spacecraft through a ground network. Raw exposures are retained and processed with versioned calibration references. Imaging and spectroscopy follow separate branches. The archive exposes raw and calibrated data with quality information. Selected relationships are shown; this is not an exact model of a particular mission.

g.text: A fictional mission informed by NASA and STScI. Selected science-data and operational relationships; hardware detail is omitted.
Solid: data or metadata · Dashed: commands or operational dependencies · → Linked guide · ↓ Page note · ↗ Reference
